## A standard gets better every time it&rsquo;s used. {#together}
::: {style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 640px; gap: 2em; align-items: center; margin-top: 1.6em;"}
::: {}
- Try it on your use case.
- Request a feature, or argue with the design.
- Build a reader or a connector.
- Pilot it with your team.

::: {.lede style="margin-top: 1.4em; font-size: 0.8em;"}
datom grew out of daapr, data as a product in R. daapr carries on as its own package; data products built on datom are next.
:::
